evaluations.limitation_addressed: Predictive relationships differ across market regimes
evaluations.simpler_alternative: Separate linear models per regime (same complexity)
evaluations.falsification_path: If regime differential < 0.010 on confirmatory data, hypothesis fails
evaluations.verdict: JUSTIFIED — directly supported by Phase 36-R evidence

evaluations.limitation_addressed: Linear models may miss nonlinear price-macro interactions
evaluations.evidence_source: Phase 22-R (infrastructure validated), yield curve branch (Ridge stronger than Lasso)
evaluations.simpler_alternative: Explicit interaction features with linear model
evaluations.falsification_path: If tree models show no incremental IC over linear models, nonlinearity is not supported
evaluations.verdict: JUSTIFIED — infrastructure exists, evidence from yield curve suggests linear may be sufficient

evaluations.limitation_addressed: Different regimes may require fundamentally different predictive models
evaluations.evidence_source: No ORBIT evidence — speculative extension of regime hypothesis
evaluations.simpler_alternative: Separate models per regime achieves similar effect with simpler architecture
evaluations.additional_data_required: Regime labels (available), gating mechanism training data
evaluations.falsification_path: If separate models per regime show no improvement, MoE is not justified
evaluations.verdict: NOT_JUSTIFIED_YET — simpler regime-conditioned models should be tested first

evaluations.limitation_addressed: Market regimes may be latent (not observed) rather than predefined
evaluations.simpler_alternative: Predefined regime classification (Phase 37-R) tests the simpler claim first
evaluations.confirmatory_testing_feasibility: LOW — latent states are hard to validate
evaluations.falsification_path: If predefined regimes show no effect, latent regime models are unlikely to help
evaluations.verdict: NOT_JUSTIFIED — predefined regime testing must complete first

evaluations.evidence_source: No ORBIT evidence for temporal modelling superiority
evaluations.simpler_alternative: Lag features (RET_5D, RET_10D, RET_20D) provide temporal representation
evaluations.confirmatory_testing_feasibility: LOW — data insufficient for deep learning
evaluations.falsification_path: If lag features capture temporal structure, sequential models are not needed
evaluations.verdict: NOT_JUSTIFIED — data insufficient, simpler alternatives exist

evaluations.limitation_addressed: Local temporal patterns in feature sequences
evaluations.simpler_alternative: Rolling window features (already used: VOL_20D, RET_20D)
evaluations.falsification_path: If rolling features capture temporal patterns, TCN not needed
evaluations.verdict: NOT_JUSTIFIED — data insufficient, rolling features exist

evaluations.limitation_addressed: Long-range temporal dependencies and cross-asset attention
evaluations.simpler_alternative: Cross-sectional features already capture cross-asset information
evaluations.falsification_path: If simpler models capture cross-asset patterns, Transformer not needed
evaluations.verdict: NOT_JUSTIFIED — far beyond current data and evidence

evaluations.limitation_addressed: Different models may capture different predictive patterns
evaluations.evidence_source: No ORBIT evidence of prediction disagreement or complementarity
evaluations.falsification_path: If single model performs as well as ensemble, ensemble not justified
evaluations.verdict: NOT_JUSTIFIED_YET — need evidence of model complementarity first
